summary: Add a locally gated AnyList item photo upload and attachment workflow.
reason: The public AnyList client contract uses multipart POST /data/photos/upload with a photo part named photo, a separate filename form field, and a generated 32-character hex UUID.jpg filename, followed by the typed set-list-item-photo-id PBListOperation with updatedValue set to that UUID. Keep the CLI behind explicit --apply, validate local image type and the 10 MiB limit, verify the item through fresh user data, and do not add cache schema fields that would silently discard photo IDs.
validated_outcome: Added multipart upload and typed attach helpers, an items photo attach command with an explicit --apply gate, local dry-run/type/size validation for JPEG, PNG, GIF, BMP, TIFF, AVIF, and WebP, and fresh read-after-write verification. User-facing README, SKILL, tools manifest, and MCP descriptions now distinguish the gated photo path from unsupported recipe photos and metadata writes. Focused client and CLI tests passed; no live AnyList writes or browser/account access were performed. Photo IDs are not persisted in the current local schema, so successful attachment reports cache_updated=false until schema support is independently approved.
